dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare Advantage organizations submitting encounter data and federal administrators processing health data.
dimensions.evidence: In the case of any encounter data submitted by a Medicare Advantage plan with respect to an item or service furnished to an individual under such plan

dimensions.assessment: Primarily administrative and reporting changes for health plans to include specific cost and assessment indicators in their data submissions.
dimensions.evidence: require that such data include-- (A) the allowed amount for such item or service; (B) the amount of cost sharing

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or major tax changes are stated; effects are confined to administrative reporting adjustments.
Amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act to add new reporting requirements for Medicare Advantage encounter data.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to require the inclusion of certain information in Medicare Advantage encounter data.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent reporting requirement effective for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027.
dimensions.evidence: with respect to an item or service furnished to an individual under such plan during a plan year beginning on or after January 1, 2027

missing_information: Financial cost to Medicare Advantage plans to update reporting systems
Exact number of health plans and beneficiaries impacted
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires Medicare Advantage plans to include specific data elements—such as allowed amounts, cost sharing, and health risk assessment indicators—in encounter data submissions starting in 2027. This directly affects Medicare Advantage organizations and federal reporting systems.
